attributes.notes:
Vox.md 2.7 adds per-preset controls for optional on-device Apple Intelligence processing on Mac.

To test on an Apple Intelligence-compatible Mac:
1. Launch Vox.md and open Capture Presets.
2. Create a preset; processing starts turned off.
3. Enable Apple Intelligence processing and choose Voice & Text, Voice Only, or Text Only.
4. Type or record a capture, choose a writable Markdown folder if prompted, and send it.
5. Confirm the Markdown note is created. Existing presets preserve their prior processing behavior, and transient on-device model errors fall back without losing the capture.

No account or demo credentials are required. Audio, transcripts, captured text, and processing remain on the Mac. The optional one-time purchase only removes free-use limits.
